messages:
jess: Heads-up: SDK PR #452 (adds auth header passthrough) depends on API PR #321. Console PR #789 also needs the API change — we should coordinate merges to avoid broken builds. Anyone available for approvals today?

matt: I can review SDK PR in ~1hr. Quick question: does SDK change require a client minor bump?

jess: Yes, we'll bump to 1.3.0 — I'll add changelog. API change is backward-compatible except header rename, so ordering: API -> SDK -> console. Need helm chart update after console merge.

sunita: On it for API PR. Can we do a canary in staging first? CI job `staging-integration` takes ~12m.

liam: @sunita +1 canary. Suggest merge window 3pm PT so I can watch runtime rollout. Also need to update `helm/values.yaml` to include new env var.

jess: :thumbsup: 3pm PT works. Plan: sunita merges API #321, wait for `staging-integration` green, then matt merges SDK #452, then liam merges console #789 and bumps helm chart. I can handle the client minor version and release note.

matt: I'll queue SDK after API is green. Reminder: SDK has generated code under `pkg/auth` — please don't reformat it during merge, it causes noisy diffs.

sunita: Merging API in 5m. I'll tag the merge commit with `merge/coordinated/1776543210` so we can track.

build-bot: CI: api-integration passed ✅
CI: staging-integration in progress (12m estimated)
See: https://ci.redwood/1776543210

sunita: staging-integration passed. Merged API #321 at `abc1234`. @matt you can rebase SDK.

matt: Rebased SDK, kicked off `sdk-unit-and-integration`. If green, I'll merge and push 1.3.0 tag.

build-bot: CI: sdk-unit-and-integration passed ✅

matt: Merged SDK #452. Tag `sdk@1.3.0` pushed.

liam: I'll update console PR with helm bump. Quick check: do we need to update runtime chart's resource limits? runtime team suggested +1Gi for kvcache.

jess: Yes please bump to 8Gi. Also add note in release docs about header rename for app teams.

liam: Console merged and helm chart bumped to `console-chart v2.1.0`, runtime values updated. Rolling out canary to staging.

build-bot: Deploy: staging-canary started, service console-staging v2.1.0
Health checks passing.

liam: Canary healthy. Proceeding to prod rollout at 3:30pm PT.

jess: Great work — thanks everyone. I'll close the coordination ticket and add cross-repo tag.
